assessment.summary: Beta.98 source review: Aquarea 1.8.0 requires SDK 1.4.0, whose parser separates eco/comfort from operation_status, rebuilds real per-device zones and reports actual LIVE/CACHED status. SolarPilot processes this as a distinct loaded-source capability, binding the actual manager/parser/helper/getter chain and final typed LIVE status. Cached successful updates cannot renew programme, action or display evidence. Existing specialStatus records keep their original labels and shape; no historical unknown is promoted. Independent context, meter, timestamp and actuator boundaries remain. The SDK consumption-report wrapper retains the old bucket API and timezone payload; Aquarea HA energy entities and native UTC period evidence remain unchanged. SDK PR12 is closed unmerged; the related correction is released through PR16. Local source/native/display/retained-evidence and energy regressions pass; actual nine canonical function-body fingerprints match the pinned primary SDK source. Details and release-validation limits are recorded in docs/AQUAREA_UPSTREAM_REVIEW_BETA98.md.
